description: Anchor format with nested child assets (sub-equipment inside vessels) vs. nested JSON with sub_equipment arrays. Tests deep asset hierarchy mapping between Anchor's $concept-based nesting and JSON array nesting.
notes: Nested hierarchy: Reactor contains Agitator and TempSensor. HeatExchanger contains CoolantPump. Anchor uses nested 'assets' dicts, JSON uses 'sub_equipment' arrays. Pressure maps to PRESS, speed/flow to VEL.
